update china_road set rev_cost = 9999999999, cost = 999999999, time_cost = 999999999, time_rev_cost = 999999999 where gid in
(select gid from china_road where ST_DWithin(geom,ST_Geometryfromtext(#{point}),0.05) order by ST_Distance(geom,ST_GeometryFromText(#{point})) limit 1)

update china_road set cost = case when direction = '3' then 999999999 else length::double precision end , rev_cost = case when direction = '2' then 999999999 else length::double precision end ,
time_cost = case when direction = '2' then case when speedclass = '2' then length::double precision / 115 when speedclass = '3' then length::double precision / 95 when speedclass = '4' then length::double precision / 80 when speedclass = '5' then length::double precision / 60 when speedclass = '6' then length::double precision / 40 when speedclass = '7' then length::double precision / 20 when speedclass = '8' then length::double precision / 10 end else 999999999 end ,
time_rev_cost = case when direction = '3' then case when speedclass = '2' then length::double precision / 115 when speedclass = '3' then length::double precision / 95 when speedclass = '4' then length::double precision / 80 when speedclass = '5' then length::double precision / 60 when speedclass = '6' then length::double precision / 40 when speedclass = '7' then length::double precision / 20 when speedclass = '8' then length::double precision / 10 end else 999999999 end where gid in
(select gid from china_road where ST_DWithin(geom,ST_Geometryfromtext(#{point}),0.05) order by ST_Distance(geom,ST_GeometryFromText(#{point})) limit 1)
